Also, I need to verify:
1. Haste keyword works properly (can attack and use activated abilities the turn it enters)
2. Regeneration: when destroyed, it regenerates (taps, removes damage, removes from combat)
3. Regeneration shields are cleared at end of turn (cleanup step)

Looking at the destruction.rs file, when `try_destroy` is called:


The destruction logic checks for indestructibility first, then looks at available regeneration shields. If shields exist, it triggers the regenerate function which taps the permanent, clears all damage and deathtouch markers, decrements the shield count, and removes it from combat. The cleanup step in engine.rs properly resets all regeneration shields back to zero for battlefield permanents.
